_comment: Provo — generation-A workbook. NOT YET IMPORTED. Read-only projection only. envelope is NOW SET (derived 2026-07-31 from the MSA county list, not from the observed bbox) — see _envelope_comment for the counties used, the derivation rule and the containment cross-check.
_envelope_comment: Derived from the Provo-Orem, UT MSA COUNTY LIST, not from the observed venue bounding box. The observed bbox is only a LOWER bound — it says where the venues we happened to find are, not where the metro is, so an envelope cut to it would reject a legitimate future venue near the metro edge. Envelope = the union of the OSM boundary-polygon bounding boxes for the 2 MSA counties (Utah, Juab), Juab (Utah)), rounded OUTWARD to 0.01 deg. Cross-check: contains all 40 geocoded venue(s) of 42 in this batch (observed lat 39.9540..40.4510, lng -112.0389..-111.5881). Wide box for the same reason as Ogden: Juab County runs west to the Nevada line (-114.05). Its latitude band (39.31..40.58) does not overlap Ogden's (40.76..42.01), so the two Utah metros stay disjoint.
